title: Deers Rock — Deterministic Healthcare Microsimulation (Reopening Audit Artifact)
description: A standalone, deterministic micro-scale healthcare simulation (1 tick = 1 minute, 1440 ticks = 1 day) designed to function as an independent sentinel within a macro-scale world simulation through an explicit adapter boundary. This release accompanies a formal reopening audit establishing cross-process determinism, per-sentinel seeded RNG, sentinel independence, and boundary isolation, while honestly reporting that the documented coupling channels (macro-to-micro and micro-to-macro) are currently inert/dead and the committed counterfactual results are unreproducible artifacts.
